title: SMOK Novo 2 X Replacement Pod - 3 Pack
description: The new Smok Novo 2X is a pocket-friendly, easy to use, affordable, versatile and extremely satisfying vape device suitable for all levels of vaper. It features an 800mAh battery, auto-inhale and automatic coil recognition, as well as compatibility with Novo and Novo 2 pods. These replacement Smok Novo 2X 2ml refillable pods feature a built-in 0.9ohm, 0.6ohm or 0.8ohm coil that entirely removes the need to change coils when it expires. Simply swap the pod out for a fresh one when it begins to lose flavour. The coil’s mesh build provides a faster heat-up time, an extremely flavoursome vape and a satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw, especially when used with high-PG, 50/50 and nic salt -liquids. A simple side-fill port helps prevent leaks when it’s time to refill the pod. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
